checks.invariant: AI-voice callback accepted only with valid HMAC over timestamp.body; tenant from stored call; idempotent redelivery
checks.result: Fails closed 503 when secret empty; timestamp freshness; hash_equals HMAC-SHA256; tenant from ai_calls row; event dedupe; no exploitable gap found (one shared provider secret is a trusted peer).

checks.invariant: Telegram updates accepted only from Telegram; link tokens bind a chat to one user without replay
checks.result: Laravel: secret header hash_equals, update_id dedupe, token rotated on bind. Worker route has no secret check and token not rotated, but exploiting needs the 128-bit token held only by the owner; recorded as hardening.

checks.invariant: client_credentials issues tokens only for valid parent key without scope escalation
checks.result: hash_equals on sha256 key_hash; parent_id IS NULL required; revoked/expired rejected; scope subset; cap 50 tokens. Non-atomic limiter is hardening only.

checks.invariant: Public lead forms derive tenant only from public_key, enforce origin allowlist, no dangerous redirect
checks.result: Tenant from lead_forms row; origin check is CORS-style (spoofable) with per-IP limit 5/min, impact limited to spam in own tenant; widget follows redirect_url only if ^https?://.

hardening: api/routes/notifications.ts:5-15 (Worker): Telegram webhook has no X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token check and link_token is not rotated/cleared after binding (line 12); parity with Laravel TelegramLinks::bind would remove forged-update and token-replay exposure.
backend/app/Services/TelegramBot.php:84-91: invite_ relay sends the invite URL to any chat supplying a pending invite token; bind to invitee.
backend/app/Http/Controllers/OAuthController.php:23-27 and LeadFormController.php:155-158: non-atomic Cache get/put rate limits; use RateLimiter::hit or Cache::add/increment.
LeadFormController::allowOrigin trusts spoofable Origin header; CORS only, not authentication.

AiVoiceWebhookController uses one global HMAC secret for all tenants and looks up provider_call_id globally; safe only while provider_call_id is unique and unguessable; unique index on ai_calls.provider_call_id not confirmed.
